title: After #25335 moves the desk scan builder into its own unit, a build that survives a trader restart is labelled 'interrupted' but its packet is never committed or posted, because commit + wake post still run in the trader thread that died. On startup, the trader should adopt a finished survivor's result.json (same bar, packet complete) and commit + post it, so a deploy mid-build no longer loses the wake. No gate, no delay; Prime Directive (keep trying, one red flag on repeated failure).
note: Filed by AM-OPS 14:48Z from lane DESK-TRIGGER-SCAN-TIMEOUT limit (1). Depends on #25331 + #25335. Check: restart the trader mid-build; the survivor packet posts on PR 17895 within the bar.
